title: Relational Retrieval: Leveraging Known-Novel Interactions for Generalized Category Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.09420v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this study, we tackle Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) via a Relational Retrieval perspective, explicitly coupling labeled and unlabeled data through bidirectional knowledge transfer. While existing methods treat these sources separately, missing valuable interaction opportunities, we propose Relational Pattern Consistency (RPC) that enables mutual enhancement. RPC employs One-vs-All classifiers for soft ID/OOD decomposition, then introduces two mechanisms: (i) for known-class preservation, we transfer semantic behavioral alignment; (ii) for category discovery, we leverage the insight that samples from the same category maintain invariant relationships with known-class prototypes, transforming unreliable pseudo-labeling into well-defined relational pattern matching. This bidirectional design allows labeled data to guide unlabeled learning while discovering novel categories through their collective relational signatures.

translated_title: 关系检索：利用已知-新颖交互实现广义类别发现
translated_abstract: 本研究从关系检索的视角解决广义类别发现（GCD）问题，通过双向知识迁移显式地耦合有标签数据与无标签数据。现有方法将这些数据源分开处理，错失了宝贵的交互机会，而我们提出的关联模式一致性方法能够实现两者的相互增强。RPC采用One-vs-All分类器进行软性的分布内/分布外分解，随后引入两种机制：（i）对于已知类别的保持，我们迁移语义行为对齐；（ii）对于类别发现，我们利用这样一个洞察——来自同一类别的样本与已知类别原型之间保持不变的关系，从而将不可靠的伪标签转化为明确定义的关系模式匹配。这种双向设计使有标签数据能够指导无标签学习，同时通过样本的集体关系签名来发现新类别。
tldr: 该论文提出关联模式一致性（RPC）方法，通过双向知识迁移耦合有标签与无标签数据，将不可靠的伪标签转化为关系模式匹配，在保持已知类别的同时发现新类别。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Relational Pattern Consistency (RPC), which couples labeled and unlabeled data through bidirectional knowledge transfer, transforming unreliable pseudo-labeling into relational pattern matching to preserve known classes while discovering novel categories.
